ogdoad: A thing made up of eight parts.
ogee: A double curve in the shape of an elongated S; an object of that shape.
oghamic: In, of, or pertaining to Ogham.
ogival: Having the curved, pointed shape of an ogive.
ogive: The curve of a cumulative distribution function.
ogle: To stare at (someone or something), especially impertinently, amorously, or covetously.
ogled: simple past and past participle of ogle
ogling: Action of the verb to ogle.
ogre: A large, grotesque, brutish humanoid monster, typically marked by great strength and a propensity to kill or devour humans.
ogreish: Resembling an ogre; cruel and wicked.
ogreism: The character or manners of an ogre.
